documents.title: Cooperative UAV Encirclement with Centralized Training
documents.abstract: This study coordinates multiple aircraft around a moving target while preserving safe separation.

sections.title: Reward Design
paragraphs: The team reward combines progress toward the target with a collision penalty and a boundary penalty. A formation bonus is issued only when every aircraft occupies its assigned sector.

sections.title: Training Architecture
paragraphs: During learning, a centralized critic consumes joint observations from all vehicles. At deployment, each decentralized actor selects an action from its own local observation.

documents.title: Single Image Dehazing with a Physical Prior
documents.abstract: The method restores outdoor photographs degraded by suspended particles.

sections.title: Atmospheric Model
paragraphs: The reconstruction estimates a transmission map and global atmospheric light before recovering scene radiance from the hazy observation.

sections.title: Optimization
paragraphs: An edge-aware regularizer smooths the transmission estimate while retaining discontinuities near object boundaries.

documents.title: Energy-Aware Scheduling for Inspection Drones
documents.abstract: A scheduler assigns inspection routes under uncertain wind and battery consumption.

sections.title: Energy Policy
paragraphs: A route is accepted only when predicted battery reserve remains above twenty percent after returning to the charging station.

sections.title: Safety Constraints
paragraphs: Flights are postponed when forecast wind exceeds the vehicle limit or when a mandatory landing corridor is unavailable.
